name: gramity
description: Gramity — custodial DCA executor on TON mainnet. Conversational control via Mira; no funds flow through Mira.

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: Returns portfolio summary, active strategies, and masked withdrawal address for a Gramity user.

tools.name: create_strategy
tools.description: Create or update a DCA strategy. Withdrawal address is locked at onboarding and cannot be changed via Mira.

tools.name: pause_strategy
tools.description: Pause the active DCA strategy for a user.
